title: Both Kings in the Open
setup: The kings are two squares apart on b5 and d5, and Black's queen, rook and bishop are all pointing your way.
hint: Every quiet move loses. Look for the check that pushes its king toward your rook, not away from it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qb7+}} sends the king to the a-file, {{Ka4}} or {{Ka5}}, and either way the rook swings across for {{Ra6#}}. Driving a king to the edge is not always the plan — driving it toward your own pieces is.
